name: Pin header, 1x4, 2.54 mm pitch (straight, male)
blurb: A short piece of 0.1 inch pin strip: a jumper lead pushes onto each pin, or it is the test point or plug for a module.

pins.note: Left pin seen from above. A bare strip has no marking: pin 1 is whichever end you decide, so label it in the wiring.

verify: Pitch, pin size, insulator size, pin heights and 3 A rating are from the Wurth WR-PHD 61300211121 (2-pin) sheet; only that sheet was read. The 4-pin length (10.16 mm) is computed from 2.54 mm per pin, not read from a 4-pin sheet. Pad positions match the KiCad footprint (which runs along y; this file runs along x). Strips are sold as 1x40 and snapped to length.
sources: https://www.we-online.com/components/products/datasheet/61300211121.pdf (Wurth Elektronik WR-PHD 61300211121 2-pin header sheet, read: pitch 2.54, pin 0.64 square, insulator 2.54 wide and high, pin 6.0 above the insulator, 3.0 tail, 3 A; length per pin count computed from the pitch)
